places.name: Laboni Beach
places.description: The main city beach of Cox's Bazar, known for its vibrant atmosphere, colourful fishing boats and golden sands. Perfect for sunrise walks and people-watching.

places.name: Sugandha Beach
places.description: A lively beach strip with amusement rides, seafood stalls and beach gear shops. Popular with families and tourists looking for a fun beach experience.

places.name: Kolatoli Beach
places.description: A long, quieter stretch south of the main town area. Kolatoli offers beautiful views and a slightly calmer beach environment, ideal for strolls and photography.

places.name: Inani Beach
places.description: One of the most scenic beaches in Bangladesh, known for its unique coral stone formations and crystal-clear turquoise waters. Located about 32 km south of Cox's Bazar town.

places.name: Himchari National Park
places.description: A protected national park featuring lush green hills, a seasonal waterfall, and beautiful sea views. Home to diverse wildlife and one of the best viewpoints in the region.

places.name: Marine Drive
places.description: An 80 km coastal highway along the Bay of Bengal — one of the longest marine drives in the world. Offers breathtaking sea views, hills and the chance to spot wildlife.

places.name: Ramu Buddhist Temple Complex
places.description: A cluster of ancient Buddhist temples and monasteries in Ramu Upazila, housing centuries-old statues, artefacts, and religious artwork. A serene cultural heritage site.

places.name: Teknaf Wildlife Sanctuary
places.description: A protected wildlife sanctuary at the southern tip of Bangladesh, home to elephants, deer, and diverse birds. Gateway to Saint Martin's Island.

places.name: Cox's Bazar Burmese Market
places.description: A bustling local market famous for Burmese goods, handicrafts, dried fish, and local souvenirs. A vibrant cultural experience with unique products.

places.name: Aggmeda Khyang Buddhist Monastery
places.description: The largest Buddhist monastery in Bangladesh, containing an 8-foot bronze Buddha statue and hundreds of smaller idols. A significant cultural landmark.

places.name: Maheshkhali Island
places.description: The only hilly island in Bangladesh, accessible by speed boat. Known for the Adinath Temple, mangrove forests, and panoramic views. A hidden gem.

places.name: Himchari Waterfall
places.description: A seasonal waterfall inside Himchari National Park, most spectacular after monsoon rains. The trek to the waterfall passes through scenic forested hills.

places.name: Chera Dwip (Broken Island)
places.description: A stunning sandbar island near Saint Martin's, accessible only at low tide. Crystal-clear water, untouched beauty and a truly off-the-beaten-path experience.

places.name: Seagull Beach
places.description: A quiet, less-commercialised beach stretch popular with those seeking a peaceful escape. Beautiful for morning walks and photography without large crowds.

places.name: Cox's Bazar Fish Market
places.description: An authentic fish market by the harbour, showcasing the catch of the day brought in by local fishermen. A fascinating glimpse into the fishing culture of the region.

places.name: Himchari Hilltop Viewpoint
places.description: The highest accessible viewpoint in Himchari, offering a 360-degree panoramic view of the Bay of Bengal, the green hills, and the coastal landscape.

places.name: Dulahazara Safari Park
places.description: Bangladesh's largest safari park covering 900 acres, home to elephants, deer, crocodiles, and exotic birds. Great for families and nature enthusiasts.

places.name: Beach Volleyball at Laboni
places.description: Join locals for a friendly game of beach volleyball on Laboni Beach. Equipment can be rented from nearby shops. A great way to interact with locals.

places.name: Sunset Boat Ride
places.description: Take a traditional fishing boat out on the Bay of Bengal for a stunning sunset cruise. Local boatmen offer guided tours along the coast.

places.name: Naf River Border View
places.description: The Naf River forms the border between Bangladesh and Myanmar near Teknaf. Viewing point offers a unique perspective on the river delta and border landscape.

places.name: Marine Aquarium Cox's Bazar
places.description: A small marine aquarium showcasing local sea life including colourful fish, coral exhibits, and educational displays about the Bay of Bengal ecosystem.

places.name: Cox's Bazar Lighthouse
places.description: A historic lighthouse built during British colonial times, offering panoramic views of the surrounding coastline. A quiet, photogenic spot with historical significance.

places.name: Beach Photography Walk
places.description: A self-guided photography walk along the world's longest natural sea beach, capturing fishing boats, sunrises, and local life. Best done in golden hour light.

places.name: Ramu Rubber Garden
places.description: A vast rubber plantation near Ramu with rows of tall rubber trees. A unique, photogenic green landscape rarely seen elsewhere in Bangladesh.

places.name: Cox's Bazar Night Market
places.description: An evening street market offering freshly grilled seafood, local snacks, and traditional Bangladeshi street food. Vibrant atmosphere after sunset.

restaurants.name: Jhaubon Restaurant
restaurants.description: Famous for fresh-caught fish curries, hilsa dishes and seafood thali. A local favourite for authentic Bangladeshi coastal cuisine.

restaurants.name: Ocean View Café
restaurants.description: A rooftop café with views of the sea. Serves a mix of Bangladeshi and continental breakfast, lunch, and dinner options.

restaurants.name: Mermaid Café
restaurants.description: One of the most popular seafood restaurants, known for BBQ lobster, grilled fish and shrimp. Great beach ambience.

restaurants.name: Hotel Motel Zone Rooftop
restaurants.description: Upscale rooftop dining with panoramic beach views. International menu with local specialities. Perfect for special dinners.

restaurants.name: Poushee Restaurant
restaurants.description: No-frills traditional Bangladeshi restaurant serving rice, dal, fish curries and biriyani. Excellent value for money.

restaurants.name: Sea Breeze Restaurant
restaurants.description: A relaxed beachside restaurant serving fresh seafood, grilled dishes and local favourites in a breezy atmosphere.

restaurants.name: Chittagong Hotel Dhaba
restaurants.description: Serves Chittagong-style dishes including mezzban beef, shuti ilish and traditional breakfasts. Popular with local workers.

restaurants.name: Beach Garden Restaurant
restaurants.description: An open-air beach garden restaurant known for whole-grilled fish, lobster and crab. Seats under palm trees with sea breeze.

restaurants.name: Fresh Coconut Corner
restaurants.description: Beach-side stall serving fresh tender coconut water, fried snacks, jhalmuri and local beach treats. Perfect light bite.

restaurants.name: Marine Drive Barbeque
restaurants.description: Roadside barbeque spot along Marine Drive, famous for freshly grilled seafood with the sea breeze. Best at sunset.

hotels.name: Long Beach Hotel
hotels.description: A premium beachfront resort with stunning sea views, modern rooms, a rooftop pool and fine dining. Close to Kolatoli Beach.

hotels.name: Sea Crown Hotel
hotels.description: A comfortable mid-range hotel centrally located with clean rooms, air conditioning and easy beach access.

hotels.name: Hotel Motel Zone View
hotels.description: A well-located hotel within walking distance of the beach strip. Comfortable rooms with good amenities at a reasonable price.

hotels.name: Seagull Hotel
hotels.description: A popular hotel with well-maintained rooms, multiple dining options and excellent service. Located near Seagull Beach.

hotels.name: Cox's Today Hotel
hotels.description: A budget-friendly guesthouse in a central location, perfect for backpackers and budget travellers. Clean basic rooms.

hotels.name: Saimon Beach Resort
hotels.description: An upscale beachfront resort offering luxury rooms with private balconies, beach access, spa services and multiple restaurants.

hotels.name: Hotel Blue Marine
hotels.description: A solid mid-range hotel near the hotel zone, offering clean rooms with AC, free breakfast and friendly staff.

hotels.name: Coral Reef Guest House
hotels.description: A budget guesthouse with basic but clean rooms. Ideal for solo travellers and budget-conscious visitors. Very central location.
